items.title: Orchestra financial assistance rental form closes
items.detail: Only applies if you are requesting a school owned instrument. Otherwise ignore and wait for the general rental window.

items.title: Violin comes to school for the first time
items.detail: Grade 6 start date. Strings is block 4B, so the violin goes in on B and D days only and comes home the same day. Bring it in earlier if it still needs finger tapes.

items.title: Bus is assigned and running
items.detail: Three late bus notifications came through between 8:32 and 8:51 this morning, so the route is active. Stopfinder still has not sent the invite you requested on Aug 10.

items.title: No Art 6 supply list yet
items.detail: Five of six teachers have sent syllabi. Nothing from Ms. Thiele. Expect a supply ask in the first week.

items.title: Mountain Messenger, Volume 3 Issue 1
items.detail: The school newsletter published Aug 16. Image based, so open it directly.

items.title: Violin chosen, rental and fitting still to do
items.detail: Rent from a shop and have her sized in person. The directors name Day Violins and say not to buy online. Needs rosin, a shoulder rest, a tuner, a cleaning cloth, a case tag and a home music stand.

items.title: Spectrum needs a two pocket folder
items.detail: It stays in Ms. Cumberledge's classroom all year. Plus pencils and the Chromebook with its charger.

items.title: Spectrum grades will never show in ParentVUE
items.detail: That class gives no traditional grades and uses the Schoology gradebook only. Rubrics plus two semester self assessments. A blank ParentVUE line for Spectrum is expected.

scans.summary: Read the Spectrum syllabus linked from Ms. Cumberledge's email. Added a folder to supplies, the two week late window, and the fact that Spectrum posts no grades to ParentVUE.
